query_authoring.seed_excerpt_strategy: split at retained file markers; hash-order eligible sections; select first section with 384-768 tokens
query_authoring.system:
You write one natural user question for a RAG study.
Use only the supplied public documentation excerpt. Follow the requested
question style. The question must be answerable from the excerpt, must not
mention the excerpt, and must not request opinions or outside knowledge.
Return exactly one question ending in a question mark and no other text.
query_authoring.validation: one non-empty line, at most 240 characters, ending in '?'

hosted_cost_guard_usd.limit_action: stop before request; never change configuration
hosted_cost_guard_usd.missing_usage_action: charge the request's conservative preflight maximum
hosted_cost_guard_usd.preflight_input_estimate: charge one token per UTF-8 input byte as a conservative upper bound
hosted_cost_guard_usd.preflight_oversize_action: stop before request and record failure

pipeline_order: author one query with pinned local model
chunk and index the complete source family
retain eligible trace without semantic inspection

reference_environment.environment_rule: record exact installed versions and hashes before the first run; any difference requires a pre-run lock amendment

retry_policy.exhausted_action: record collection failure; do not replace

temporal_source_condition.rule: No temporal slot may be created until two distinct, approved, hash-pinned source snapshots and an independent authority basis exist for its pair.
